hero.body: This mentorship programme was built around one goal: making you employable, not just knowledgeable. Through practical projects, expert mentorship, and real-world experience, you'll develop the skills employers hire for.
hero.subline: Every successful Business Analyst started exactly where you are today.

programme.label: The programme
programme.title: Everything you need to become BA-ready
programme.intro: More than a course, this is a structured mentorship programme designed to bridge the gap between learning Business Analysis and becoming a Business Analyst.
programme.featuredText: Designed to bridge the gap between learning and doing Business Analysis. Through hands-on projects across the Software Development Lifecycle, you'll build a professional portfolio, practical experience, and stand out to employers.

serviceCards.title: CV Workshop
serviceCards.text: Turn your experience into a CV recruiters notice.

serviceCards.title: Career Mentoring
serviceCards.text: Learn from a mentor who's walked and succeeded on the path you're about to take.

serviceCards.title: Interview Preparation
serviceCards.text: Mock BA interviews with feedback so you walk in with confidence.

serviceCards.title: LinkedIn Optimisation
serviceCards.text: Position yourself to attract recruiters and opportunities.

serviceCards.title: Lifetime Community
serviceCards.text: Your support network doesn’t end when the programme does.

artefacts.label: PORTFOLIO EXPERIENCE
artefacts.headline: Build BA experience across a real delivery lifecycle.
artefacts.intro: Work through a realistic Salesforce CRM implementation from discovery to deployment, create professional BA artefacts, and build practical experience you can confidently talk about in interviews.

flagship.label: FLAGSHIP CONTINUOUS PROJECT
flagship.title: Salesforce CRM Implementation
flagship.scenario: A growing organisation needs to improve how leads are captured, qualified, converted and reported through Salesforce.
flagship.roleNote: Shape, validate and communicate the change from end to end.

lifecycle.title: Discovery
lifecycle.description: Understand the business problem and stakeholder needs.
lifecycle.continuity: The evidence you uncover here becomes the foundation for the requirements that follow.

artefacts.title: Stakeholder Analysis
artefacts.caption: Influence and interest shape the engagement approach.

artefacts.title: AS-IS Lead Process
artefacts.caption: Current hand-offs reveal where leads lose momentum.

lifecycle.title: Requirements
lifecycle.description: Turn findings into clear, prioritised requirements.
lifecycle.continuity: Discovery findings are translated into agreed needs, rules and measurable outcomes.

artefacts.title: Requirements Catalogue
artefacts.caption: Prioritised needs stay clear and traceable.

artefacts.title: Jira-style User Story
artefacts.caption: A business need expressed with testable acceptance criteria.

preview.story: As a sales representative, I want each new lead assigned an agreed status so I know the next action to take.
criteria: A status is required before save
Only agreed status values are available
Status changes retain an audit trail

lifecycle.title: Design
lifecycle.description: Shape and validate how the solution should work.
lifecycle.continuity: You review solution choices against the agreed requirements and keep decisions traceable.

artefacts.title: Data Mapping
artefacts.caption: Business meaning and validation rules remain explicit.

artefacts.title: Requirement-to-Design Traceability
artefacts.caption: The BA validates design coverage without configuring Salesforce.

lifecycle.title: Test
lifecycle.description: Validate the solution and identify what needs fixing.
lifecycle.continuity: Each scenario traces back to an agreed requirement before the change can move towards release.

artefacts.title: UAT Scenario Table
artefacts.caption: Business outcomes are tested against expected behaviour.

artefacts.title: Defect Log
artefacts.caption: Issues are recorded with business impact and ownership.

rows.issue: Status label differs from agreed wording

lifecycle.title: Deploy
lifecycle.description: Support go-live and confirm the change works as intended.
lifecycle.continuity: The same requirements and test evidence now inform readiness, release support and post-go-live checks.

artefacts.title: Go-Live Readiness Checklist
artefacts.caption: Business, people and process readiness are considered together.

artefacts.title: Post-Deployment Checks
artefacts.caption: The BA confirms that the change works as intended.

rows.check: New leads enter the agreed flow

delivery.title: SIMULATION
delivery.text: Work through realistic business scenarios and project information.

delivery.title: REAL PLATFORMS
delivery.text: Gain guided exposure to platforms such as Salesforce and Trailhead.

delivery.title: MENTOR GUIDANCE
delivery.text: Receive feedback and support throughout the project.

delivery.title: PORTFOLIO EVIDENCE
delivery.text: Finish with professional BA work you can confidently showcase and explain.

secondary.heading: Then apply your skills in new business contexts.

projects.label: INDEPENDENT CHALLENGE
projects.title: HCM Transformation
projects.description: Apply your BA approach to a candidate-to-new-starter and onboarding transformation.
projects.reveal: Use the approach developed in the flagship project with greater independence.

projects.label: OPTIONAL CAPSTONE
projects.title: ERP Transformation
projects.description: Explore requisition-to-purchase-order, approvals and finance controls.
projects.reveal: Demonstrate additional breadth after completing the flagship experience.

process.label: How it works
process.title: Your BA journey, mapped like a real project.
process.intro: A clear route from beginner to supported BA professional, with practical training, live project experience, job-readiness, and ongoing career support.

steps.title: Start Your Journey
steps.text: Take the first step towards becoming a Business Analyst with Anderseed.

steps.title: Get onboarded
steps.text: Meet with me, your mentor, for a 15-minute welcome call to map out your journey and set you up for success from day one. Then unlock your training, resources, and support community.

steps.title: Learn and take action
steps.text: Work through BA concepts, practical tasks, and live project scenarios that mirror real workplace expectations.

steps.title: Build confidence
steps.text: Strengthen your BA language, stakeholder thinking, documentation skills, and ability to explain your work clearly.

steps.title: Get hired
steps.text: Confidently apply for BA roles with a standout CV, an optimised LinkedIn profile, our Signature Application Guide, and interview preparation designed to help you stand out.

steps.title: Lifetime job support group
steps.text: Stay connected after the programme for career check-ins, on-the-job support, job opportunities, and ongoing accountability.
